urs.title: See an accurate trace matrix
urs.feature: The matrix lists every top-level item with the items it traces to, level by level, as they are in Orcanos at the time of the last refresh.
urs.need: As a QA lead or auditor, I need the matrix to show exactly the items and links that exist in Orcanos — nothing added, nothing dropped — so that I can rely on it as traceability evidence.
urs.risk_why: A dropped or invented link would be read as fact in a design review.

srs.text: The L1 rows are exactly the items the L1 filter returns in Orcanos — none added, none left out — across all pages.
An item is shown under a parent if and only if the parent traces to it in Orcanos and the item is returned by that block's filter.
